messages:
Lina: Quick heads-up while onboarding Tempest11B (opt variant) into int4 pipeline — long summary generation starts repeating phrases after ~120 tokens in quantized runs. Float32 baseline ok.
Ravi: can you paste repro + conversion flags?
Lina: repro is a simple POST with quant=int4, temp=0, max_tokens=400. sample output: "the study found that the study found that the study found that..."
Tao: sounds like positional modulation collapsed. Tempest uses hybrid rotary+absolute concat; tiny rotary freqs getting clamped to zero during calibration would cause that.
Lina: converter log excerpt: [convert] layer=34 head=6 qk_scale mean=7.3e-05 -> clipped 0.0; rotary_freqs min=6.1e-07 clipped->0.0
Ravi: we introduced an aggressive min-span fallback in the calibration to avoid empty ranges. looks like it overshot.
Lina: eval-bot ran a headwise entropy probe: float32 mean_entropy=4.0 bits; int4 converted mean_entropy=1.0 bits; heads 6,13,22 show zeroed rotary freqs.
eval-bot: suggestion: re-run conversion with per-tensor min-span floor 1e-6 or mark rotary tensors mix-float.
Tao: quick test: re-converted with min-span=1e-6 and preserved per-head scale; same prompt no repetition. quality: int4(orig) ROUGE-1=0.29 ROUGE-L=0.25; int4(minspan1e-6) ROUGE-1=0.45 ROUGE-L=0.41; float32=0.47/0.43.
Ravi: action items: revert aggressive global clamp; add per-tensor floor 1e-7 with headwise override 1e-6 for rotary; add unit test asserting no 3x repeated ngram in long-gen; runtime guard to mixfloat q/k if rotary_freqs effectively zero.
Lina: added tokenizer parity check too (Tempest normalizes ZWJ U+200D); confirmed same NFKC path. will open PR with artifacts and run ids.
Tao: thanks — once CI + bench green, promote new int4 recipe and deprecate old artifact.
